baseBranch.description: Deprecated: set base under settings: (every flow) or flows.<name>.settings, the branch a flow's work starts from and targets. It never chose the branch .chernabog/ is read from, which is GitHub's default. A flow's base wins over this.

settings.description: Settings every flow shares, such as the reviewer pool (reviewers), the CI limits (ciRounds, ciTimeout) and the local gate (localGate, install), read by the flows whose settings declare them. flows.<name>.settings overrides them key by key.

anyOf.description: Deprecated: set install under settings: (every flow) or flows.<name>.settings, where the flows that use it read it. A flow's settings win over this.

runners.description: GitHub logins that run this by default: chernabog enroll offers it to them and not to others. Anyone's when unset. A person can still list the flow for themselves in machine config.

announcePhases.description: Whether each phase an item advances to is announced with a repository_dispatch of chernabog-phase, which starts this repo's CI workflow for the item's next step. Every machine announces, a laptop's too. Default true; false sends none, and a CI sweep finds the item instead.

reviewers.description: The reviewer pool, by GitHub login. Deprecated: set reviewers under settings: (every flow) or flows.<name>.settings, where the flows that use it read it. A flow's settings win over this.

agent.description: The adapter this flow's agent steps run with, over the repo's agent.

agents.description: Adapters by role, such as { reviewer: codex }: a step given { role } runs with that role's adapter, falling back to this flow's agent and then the repo's.

anyOf.description: Deprecated: set assignee under flows.<name>.settings, where the flows that route with the SDK's Routing read it. Given to the flow as that setting until then; its own settings win over this.
Deprecated: set reviewRequested under flows.<name>.settings, where the flows that route with the SDK's Routing read it. Given to the flow as that setting until then; its own settings win over this.

settings.description: The flow's own settings, which its settings schema declares, over the repo's shared settings: key by key.

runners.description: GitHub logins that run this by default: chernabog enroll offers it to them and not to others. Anyone's when unset. A person can still list the flow for themselves in machine config.

from.description: Runs this flow from a recipe package installed in .chernabog/ (its package.json's dependencies), instead of a file in flows/: "<package>/<recipe>", such as "@chernabog/recipes/review". The package's team owns it; a prompt in prompts/ overrides the package's. chernabog recipes eject copies it in.

flows.description: The flows that run on GitHub Actions: the plan job runs their triggers and starts a run job for each item it would start. Flows not named keep running only on a daemon.

maxParallel.description: The most run jobs at once, across every flow: the run job's strategy.max-parallel. 1 when unset.

schedule.description: When the sweep runs, as a cron expression in UTC: it plans across every item, for what a dropped event missed. "17 */3 * * *" when unset; schedule at an odd minute, since GitHub drops scheduled runs under load, most on the hour.

ci.description: Running flows on GitHub Actions: which flows, how many run jobs at once, and when the sweep runs.
